name: Joel
bio: Trip organizer. Hates cats — on principle, and Niklas's two in particular. Would honestly rather be raiding in World of Warcraft than walking a fairway.
quirk: Booked an 08:42 tee time and has no plan for being conscious at it.

name: Niklas
bio: Lives out in the countryside with two cats, both of whom have watched more of his practice swings than any human ever will.
quirk: Insists the fresh country air is worth twenty extra yards.

name: Jacob
bio: Girl-dad who gets paid to play video games at work, and maintains that this is legitimate training for reading greens.
quirk: Counts respawning as a free drop.

bio: Turns up in slippers, on a knee that has strong opinions about uphill lies, with a swing assembled entirely from YouTube tutorials.
